title: ESP32 Hall sensor: chip variants and external sensors

spans.text: A Hall sensor detects magnetic fields. Older original ESP32 chips had an internal Hall sensor and legacy APIs; families such as ESP32-S2/S3/C3 do not have the same integrated sensor. Do not assume every ESP32 board includes one.

spans.caption: ESP32 Hall sensor: chip variants and external sensors

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: The sketch uses an external digital Hall module: connect its output to a suitable GPIO. The code assumes push-pull output; add a suitable pull-up for open-drain modules, and use an ADC for analog output.
